[Rating: 8/10] Played today at a game fair with my two boys, aged 11 and 5.  Very fun to play, can't wait to see it in color.  All three of us really enjoyed the game.

[Rating: 8/10] A straightforward and quick duel filler about building and destroying castles. Cards can be used either for building your castle or abilities that are mainly about attacking opponents castle. It might look very simple but there’s room for some planning and clever moves. It’s like Faraway or Castle Combo (or even better) but it’s not a solitaire multiplayer. Also I really enjoy the art. Each faction feels unique and has some unique elements on the cards.   2P experience: Great Interaction: High - negative Setup time: Low
